the buckling-induced compaction in soft porous structures can be controlled by the shape of the pore, and that the compaction of a soft structure can be tuned by changing the shape of its holes.

understanding the mechanical response of 2D periodic, soft and porous structures, and the effect of pore shape on the mechanical response.
the mechanics of soft, periodic, cellular structures that are composed of a solid matrix with periodic arrays of holes.
the design of soft and porous structures and the study of the compaction through buckling in such structures.

the compaction through buckling is a robust mechanism to design soft and foldable materials with a desired response.
